How it works

1

Paste the company URL

Enter any company website — homepage, about page, or team page — into DatIQ's URL field.

2

Click "Contacts & Emails"

Select the Contacts extraction type from the enrichment tab. DatIQ immediately begins scanning the page.

3

View structured contacts

Receive a clean list of names, titles, emails, and social profiles — no manual copying or parsing required.

4

Export to CSV or copy to CRM

Download the full contact list as CSV, or copy individual entries directly into your CRM or outreach tool.
